program.title: Program details
program.intro: The complete reference for membership, affiliate rewards, investments and payouts. Public store pages do not include these details.
program.membershipBody: Every member receives one permanent Member ID. A sponsor is selected only at registration and cannot be changed. Membership becomes active automatically after the first order paid from Available Balance.
program.plansIntro: Two plan types are available. Existing investments keep the terms recorded when they were created.
program.installmentBody: The invested capital is returned in equal monthly installments over the agreed term. Example: 100,000 SP over 14 months returns about 7,142 SP of capital each month. Each month also receives a share of that month's announced net profit, calculated on the capital still in the business. Capital cannot be withdrawn before the term ends.
program.profitOnlyBody: Your principal stays in the business and earns a share of the announced net profit every month. There is no capital withdrawal for the first 12 months. After the lock-in you may withdraw at any time by giving two months' notice; profit keeps accruing while the principal remains.
program.planNote: Capital, distributable profit, installments and affiliate rewards are recorded in separate balances. Profit shares depend on actual distributable profit and are never guaranteed.
program.affiliateBody: Rewards may be earned from the first three upline levels when a qualifying investment is verified. Rates follow the active settings version at the time of qualification.
program.noBackfill: If an upline level is skipped or ineligible at the time, that reward is permanently skipped and is not backfilled later.
program.sponsorOnlyRewards: All three affiliate levels follow the permanent sponsor/upline chain. Placement position never affects these rewards.
program.distributionBody: Distributable profit is weighted by the capital still in each active investment using largest-remainder rounding, so every SP is accounted for. Allocations are posted by an administrator and recorded in the ledger.
program.walletBody: Available, Investment, Profit and Affiliate balances stay separate. Transfer Profit or Affiliate funds into Available before requesting a withdrawal. Profit Only principal can be withdrawn after the lock-in by giving two months' notice.
program.rule1: Member IDs are assigned sequentially and permanently at registration.
program.rule2: Membership becomes active automatically after the first order paid from Available Balance.
program.rule3: Sponsor relationships are permanent and set only at registration.
program.rule4: Skipped affiliate rewards are not backfilled.
program.rule5: Available withdrawals are reviewed by an administrator. Profit Only principal requires a two-month notice after the 12-month lock-in; profit continues until the principal is released.
program.riskBody: Investments are not deposits and are not insured. Distributions depend on actual distributable profit and are never guaranteed. Please read the full agreement before investing.
program.disclosureBody: Profit distributions are allocations of actual distributable business profit, not a guaranteed return. Investment terms, eligibility and distributions are subject to the applicable agreement and laws.

about.title: A community built around everyday wellbeing
about.intro: Savelife CSM brings together a member store, a transparent affiliate programme and long-term investment management in one simple platform.
about.storyBody: We started Savelife CSM to make everyday essentials easier to access while giving members a clear way to grow together. What began as a small shared store has grown into a structured membership community with its own rewards, events and support.
about.missionBody: Make quality products affordable, keep every reward understandable, and create a dependable space where members can learn, participate and build together.
about.storeBody: A curated store for wellness, daily essentials, home and personal care, with wallet payments and member-only benefits.
about.communityBody: Regular meetups, training sessions and programmes help members connect, share experience and celebrate progress together.
about.investmentBody: Clear plan terms, separate balances and ledger-based tracking keep capital, profit and rewards easy to follow.
about.value1Body: Balances, transactions and plan rules are recorded so members can always see where they stand.
about.value2Body: Every product, reward and event is designed to make participation simpler and more useful for the community.
about.value3Body: Payments, approvals and physical rewards are reviewed by administrators and kept in the record.
about.ctaTitle: See what we have been doing

company.title: Company information & rules
company.aboutBody: Savelife CSM is a membership platform combining an e-commerce store, a three-level affiliate programme and an investment management service.
company.rule1: Member IDs are assigned sequentially and permanently at registration.
company.rule2: Membership becomes active automatically after the first order paid from Available Balance.
company.rule3: Sponsor relationships are permanent and set only at registration.
company.rule4: Skipped affiliate rewards are not backfilled.
company.rule5: Available withdrawals are reviewed by an administrator. Profit Only principal requires a two-month notice after the 12-month lock-in; profit continues until the principal is released.
company.riskBody: Investments are not deposits and are not insured. Distributions depend on actual distributable profit and are never guaranteed. Please read the full agreement before investing.

disclosure.title: Important information
disclosure.body: Profit distributions are allocations of actual distributable business profit, not a guaranteed return. Investment terms, eligibility and distributions are subject to the applicable agreement and laws.
